judgments.yea_description: Voted for House Bill 5520. It would bring back holding third graders back for reading, starting with students in grade 3 in the 2027-2028 school year. A student who does not score proficient in English on the state test could not move to grade 4 unless the student shows proficiency on another approved reading test or a portfolio, is proficient in every other subject, or gets a good cause exemption. Exemptions would cover students with disability plans, English learners with under 3 years of instruction, some recent transfers, students already held back after 2 years of help, and cases where a parent asks and the superintendent agrees. The House passed it 57-49. The Senate has not voted on it, so it is not law.
